name: numa

name: nvidia

NVMe is optimized for low-latency and high-throughput data access, providing faster read and write speeds compared to older storage protocols like SATA and SAS. It communicates directly with the CPU through the PCIe bus, enabling significantly higher data transfer rates and improved overall system performance, particularly for applications involving large data sets, such as gaming, video editing, and data analytics.
